corridor.basis: review-joinn: sideways to 50% of the distance to the house fronts holds at 25% and 50% along; in the gate arch (75%) the arch sides are close; rising half a camera height or lowering a quarter breaks, so height is held near the filmed height; breaks 2-5 m past the end. Ride limit set to 40%. Per-frame limits: 35% of the distance to the nearest solved points on each side (corridor.py), so the lane narrows where walls come close.
corridor.scale: metres assume 5 m between the house fronts (mean of the solved-point wall distances at 25% and 50% along); generated video has no true scale
